title: Seeing vs. Knowing: Counterfactual Supervision and Correction for 3D-Aware Object Editing
abstract: arXiv:2611.29542v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rotating, translating, or rescaling an object in a photograph requires revealing unseen surfaces, preserving visible appearance, and updating shadows and reflections. Reconstructed 3D assets, rendered at the target pose as a 3D state, provide explicit geometric guidance, but their imperfect textures may conflict with the photograph, while standard paired training does not explicitly teach the editor which source to trust. To address this, we propose counterfactual state supervision, which constructs controlled photo--state conflicts through hidden-surface repainting, hidden geometry with re-rendered shadows and reflections, and visible-surface texture replacement. This teaches the editor to follow the 3D state for unseen content while preserving photograph-visible appearance. translated_title: 看见与知晓：面向3D感知物体编辑的反事实监督与校正
translated_abstract: 对照片中的物体进行旋转、平移或缩放操作，需要揭示不可见的表面、保留可见的外观，并更新阴影与反射。将重建的3D资产在目标姿态下渲染为3D状态，可以提供显式的几何指导，但其不完美的纹理可能与照片产生冲突，而标准的成对训练并未显式地教导编辑器应信任哪个来源。为解决这一问题，我们提出了反事实状态监督，通过隐藏表面重绘、带重新渲染阴影与反射的隐藏几何、以及可见表面纹理替换来构建可控的照片-状态冲突。这教会编辑器对不可见内容遵循3D状态，同时保留照片中可见的外观。然而，学习这种区分并不能确保其在采样过程中得以保持。因此，我们进一步引入了对称反事实校正，它利用...
tldr: 提出反事实状态监督与对称反事实校正方法，教会3D感知物体编辑器在编辑时遵循3D状态生成不可见内容、同时保留照片可见外观，并确保这一区分在采样过程中得以维持。
en_tdlr: We propose counterfactual state supervision and symmetric counterfactual correction to teach 3D-aware object editors to follow the 3D state for unseen content while preserving photograph-visible appearance, and to maintain this distinction during sampling.
